upper_bound.quote: and use at most \(q-1\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted).
upper_bound.witness: The upper bound needs, for EVERY Liu division with q = n+1 intervals, an explicit Xiang reply using at most n = q-1 marks that forces D <= Gamma. The text only names the overlay/common-refinement idea and then defers the two essential verifications: (a) that the overlay of the A-row against the B-row plus bisection of the remaining intervals really produces a multiset consisting of equal pairs plus an A-tail of total length s_A - s_B, and (b) that the total number of new marks is at most q-1 (an exact count over |A|, |B|, coinciding boundaries, and the tail cut). Neither is carried out; 'details omitted' leaves the all-cases construction unproved.
upper_bound.load_bearing: The pigeonhole bound Gamma <= 1/(2^{n+1}-1) is only useful once the refinement lemma's upper half supplies an actual Xiang marking within the n-mark budget; Section 3's main case q = n+1 invokes exactly this omitted construction, and without it (8) does not follow.
